summary: [Shopify] reversibility: Most writes correctable but not atomic-undoable: products/orders editable; shipped fulfillments cannot be un-shipped (return flow instead); refunds are new money movements; inventory adjustments correctable by counter-adjustment (history preserved). No universal undelete: model as correct-forward, not rollback.
